title: Core 12-Woman #08
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 16:9 aspect ratio, significantly wider than it is tall, twelve women in a single row.

A photograph of TWELVE women standing side by side in a single row at the same ground level on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, each woman in her own distinct pose, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, all real photographic skin with visible pores, no illustration finish, no CG sheen, all faces, hands and feet in correct proportion. The camera set back so all 12 fit comfortably within the wide frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render. Exactly 12 women, no more, no fewer.

Left to right:
[telenovela glam / Brazilian Booty]: Latina woman, early 20s, cool and composed, warm golden-bronze skin, a sharp black winged liner, warm terracotta eyeshadow, heavy lashes, strong sculpted contour, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep berry lip, long voluminous dark-brown waves swept over one shoulder, a fiery, passionate expression, curly hair, square nails (holographic). dominated by hips and rear — a sharply cinched waist above a rear curving outward and upward in a high rounded shelf. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Yoruba adire eleko pattern (a deep indigo ground with bold cream resist-painted geometric motifs), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Piercings: 200pc hoops/rubies/bronze/sym. Jewellery: four to six pieces, layered of platinum a ring. Pose: seated on a low stool, hands on knees. Shoes: extreme cream extreme platform high heels.
[Lebanese Wedding Glam / Polynesian Goddess]: Lebanese woman, late 50s, cool and composed, radiant glowing bridal makeup, dramatic long lashes, a soft rose lip, warm fair skin, high ponytail hair, round nails (glossy). a broad, continuous silhouette — strong shoulders, full heavy bust, soft gentle waistline, enormous broad hips and thighs. Piercings: no piercings. Jewellery: four to six pieces, layered of platinum a necklace. Pose: leaning one arm on a window frame. Shoes: extreme magenta-and-gold platform stiletto cross-strap sandals.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, every woman an extraordinarily large woman far beyond any real person, generous horizontal spacing so every figure reads clearly and large. Exactly 12 women total.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 12, catching each woman's own painted pattern and piercings distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 16:9 landscape 8K.
